def: Red as a rose; specifically (Zoöl.), of a pure purplish redcolor. Chaucer.
Legal strength, force, or authority; that quality of a thingwhich renders it supportable in law, or equity; as, the validity of awill; the validity of a contract, claim, or title.
To wait or watch for; to be on guard against. [Obs.] Chaucer.
A throwing or tossing of the body; a shaking or agitation. Sir.W. Temple.
That which is educed, as by analysis. Sir W. Hamilton.
